introduction.title: About Hushan Forestry
introduction.subtitle: Six forestry professionals from across Taiwan
description: Hushan Forestry was founded in 2022 by six passionate forestry professionals from across Taiwan. We firmly believe that Taiwan possesses abundant forest resources, and sustainable management is the core value of forestry development.

Our team members possess professional forestry knowledge and extensive practical experience. From forest harvesting and timber trading to forest management planning, we are committed to providing the most comprehensive forestry solutions. Through scientific management methods and modern equipment, we not only emphasize economic benefits but also focus on ecological conservation and environmental sustainability.

We believe that forestry is not just about harvesting timber, but an art of coexisting with nature. Every operation is a commitment to the forest; every decision is to leave better forests for the next generation.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.subtitle: Building a sustainable future for Taiwan's forestry

sustainable.title: Sustainable Forestry Management
sustainable.description: Promoting scientific forest management models, balancing economic development and ecological conservation, ensuring that forest resources can be passed down through generations, allowing Taiwan's forests to develop sustainably.

professional.title: Professional Service Quality
professional.description: Continuously improving team professional capabilities, introducing advanced equipment and technology, providing customers with the highest quality forestry services, becoming a benchmark enterprise in the industry.

innovation.title: Industry Innovation Development
innovation.description: Combining traditional wisdom with modern technology, promoting Taiwan's forestry transformation and upgrading, cultivating new generation forestry talent, injecting innovative vitality into the industry.

ecological.title: Ecological Harmony
ecological.description: Emphasizing biodiversity protection, integrating ecological considerations into forestry operations, achieving harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, protecting Taiwan's precious forest ecosystems.

goals.title: Core Goals
goals.subtitle: The concrete actions we are committed to achieving

safety.title: Safety First
safety.description: Establishing comprehensive safety operation standards to ensure that every staff member can work in a safe environment. Regularly conducting safety education and training, reducing occupational hazards, achieving zero accident goals.

quality.title: Quality Assurance
quality.description: Strictly controlling every operational aspect, from planning, execution to acceptance, ensuring service quality meets customer expectations. Using scientific management tools, continuously optimizing operational processes, providing the best solutions.

environmental.title: Environmental Responsibility
environmental.description: Incorporating environmental impact assessments into all forestry operations, adopting low-impact operational methods, protecting water and soil resources and wildlife habitats, practicing corporate environmental social responsibility.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Transfer
knowledge.description: Through chainsaw training courses and forestry knowledge sharing, cultivating new generation forestry talent. Recording and passing down traditional forestry wisdom, combining with modern technology, promoting industry knowledge upgrading.

community.title: Community Partnership
community.description: Establishing long-term cooperative relationships with local communities, creating local employment opportunities, promoting mountain village economic development. Respecting indigenous traditional territories, jointly protecting precious forest resources.
